scenarios.description: Kaisaniemenlahti bay in snowless thermal winter: the water is ice, the ground has no snow
scenarios.why: find: Kaisaniemenranta runs along the bay shore (8 lamps, 2 buildings); mid-January is thermal winter in Helsinki, --test-snow-depth 0 keeps the ground bare.

scenarios.description: frozen_pond_snowless_winter with the taxi standing on the bay ice: lake ice carries the car, no sink countdown
scenarios.why: Kaisaniemenlahti, 50 m right of the frozen_pond_snowless_winter pose: the whole car is inside the bay's water polygon (is_car_fully_in_water). The pose check fails if the server sinks and respawns the taxi.

scenarios.description: Oulu sea bay on 28 Nov, snowless: the modelled lake ice (about 21 cm) holds and the taxi stands on it with no sink countdown
scenarios.why: The northernmost map data at hand (Oulu, 65.0 N). 427000, 7210500 is inside non-river water at least 30 m from every shore (checked with is_point_in_water on the loaded map). Snowless clear ice: lake_ice_thickness_cm(2025-11-28, 65.0, 1.0) = 21.3 cm >= CAR_ICE_MIN_CM. The pose check fails if the server sinks and respawns the taxi.

scenarios.description: frozen_pond_snowless_winter from the windshield: the 3D water area is ice in perspective
scenarios.why: Same pose and conditions; heading along Kaisaniemenranta keeps the bay on the right of the forward view.

scenarios.description: Snow falling on the city-centre street by day: flakes drift and flutter down to the ground and roofs
scenarios.why: wet_asphalt_night's pose (paved street, 4 buildings in view) in January daylight with snow; snow leaves the road dry.

scenarios.description: A ploughed lane on a white city-centre street: a dark strip with soft edges along the plough's track, no 10 m squares
scenarios.why: snow_street_day's paved straight street (4 buildings in view) in January daylight; --test-plough whitens the roads and makes the taxi plough its own track while it drives 6 s along the street with lane assist, so the lane runs diagonally behind it across the 10 m grid.

scenarios.description: Facades of several building types and colours in daylight
scenarios.why: Second inner-city street (find: 14 buildings, 4 colours, 3 commercial within 70 x 40 m). OSM gives no facade materials here: colours and categories differ, materials cannot be promised.

scenarios.description: Window glass of commercial blocks reflecting the sky, overcast-free afternoon
scenarios.why: second inner-city street has the most commercial buildings found (3) beside apartment blocks: storefront and office glazing. No mapped glass or metal facades exist in the data; this tests the window glass.

scenarios.description: A generated roadwork on a way merged by map extension, outside the start box, top-down
scenarios.why: Oulu: the start --bbox is the motorway_through_traffic 0.6 km box (start_box_center); the cold-start tile window merges the tiles around it through map sync, which adds roadworks there. The pose is the midpoint of one of them from a run's server.log (a full-road work about 1 km west of the box). Readiness needs a roadworks entry in the view outside the start box. Daylight.

scenarios.description: Street lamps through dusk, night and dawn, then driving down the street
scenarios.why: Lamp-lined city street (find: 11 street lamps within 70 x 40 m, a straight street heading south): many lamps in view; October dusk 17:30, night 22:00, dawn 07:45. Each run drives 8 s and counts lamp light reassignments.

scenarios.description: Fixed dense-city view at night for repeatable rendering measurements
scenarios.why: City-centre street, inner-city district: dense blocks, 12 lamps and 13 buildings around; night so every light pool is active; the default zoom shows the most of it.

scenarios.description: A road ferry at a ferry landing, the taxi waiting on the slip
scenarios.why: A road ferry (OSM route=ferry, ferry=secondary, 925 m): the taxi 8 m back from the route's east end, facing the deck of the ferry docked there (or under way, after its 40 s wait).

scenarios.description: The same ferry landing in the 2D view: the ferry drawn under the vehicles

scenarios.description: Train model view at a city station

scenarios.description: Fast traffic on a motorway through a mid-size city at 58 m/s: cars ahead of the taxi, passed and gone behind
scenarios.why: Motorway through a mid-size city (Oulu): a 1.76 km straight motorway from the start pose (find, 10 km Oulu world): fast traffic should be on it ahead of the taxi and not parked on it; daylight so the motorway is visible.

scenarios.description: Windshield view on a motorway through a mid-size city, driving at full throttle: traffic ahead and oncoming passes from ~70 m to ~5 m; a frame every 0.5 s
scenarios.why: Motorway through a mid-size city (Oulu): the motorway_through_traffic pose, which has fast traffic ahead of the taxi and on the other carriageway (seed 1). Every car crosses the old 22 m model swap and the 60 m radius; daylight so the cars are visible.

scenarios.description: Chase camera, full throttle up a city street onto a synthetic crest: the shot is taken while the taxi is in the air
scenarios.why: docs/specs/vehicle-airborne-physics.md: the vehicle_lineup_3d_day street (Helsinki centre, straight for 150 m). The server's --test-hill puts a 12 m synthetic ridge 137 m ahead (on a 20 m ground-grid node and the street line, so the grid gives +/-0.15 slopes); no DEM file or cache is read or written. The run fails unless the ground there is 5 m above the pose, the taxi was airborne, and the shot caught it 0.3 m above the road.

scenarios.description: A camper van, a caravan and a tent on their pitches at Nallikari camping, 2D top-down: the camper drawn at its streamed length
scenarios.why: Oulu, Nallikari camping: mapped point pitches inside the campsite; populate_camp_pitches puts a camper_van on the pitch at 425660.5, 7212600.6, a caravan 8 m west of it and a tent 16 m west (each pitch: campsites.py's 5 m envelope around the point). camera_at holds the camera between the camper and caravan pitches; the taxi waits on the campsite service road about 20 m north (pose), since on a pitch it would cover the camper and stand off the road. Zoom 5 (45 px/m) resolves the 0.24 m lights. Readiness needs the camper in view, its drawn body within 10 % of its row and each row's footprint inside its pitch. Daylight, clear.

scenarios.why: Hat placement check after the comic head enlargement: same view as pedestrian_comic_closeup_day with the walker in costume santa (5th animals field).

scenarios.description: Chase camera, full throttle onto a mapped speed hump on a Helsinki residential street: the taxi hops it, the shot is taken at the top of the hop
scenarios.why: docs/specs/terrain-following-bodies.md part 1: a real traffic_calming=hump (OSM) on a 30 km/h residential street in Helsinki, found from the server's loaded speed_bumps list (29 bumps within 1.5 km of the centre, only two humps). The pose is 45 m back on the street (about 18 m/s when the taxi reaches the hump, well over the 12 m/s a car needs to hop) and lane assist follows the bend to it. The hop is the server's (BumpFlight). The run fails unless the taxi was airborne and the shot is at the apex of the arc.

scenarios.description: A bus, a truck, a camper van and a tram standing in a row on a 15 % grade, seen from beside the street: every body is tilted with the ground
scenarios.why: docs/specs/terrain-following-bodies.md part 2: a straight Helsinki-centre street with terrain on. The server's --test-hill puts a 10 m cosine hill (radius 40 m) centred 40 m ahead of the taxi on the street line, so the street climbs with a grade of 9-19 % under the taxi and the lineup beside it (no DEM file or cache is read or written). The camera orbits the taxi to its side, so the grade shows against the buildings. The run fails unless the ground at the hill is 4.5 m above the pose, the bus and the tram are pitched at least 0.08 rad and are on screen within 22 m and at least 120 px high, and every drawn model's wheel points are within 0.025 m (the lineup, standing still; 0.016 measured on the steep grade) and 0.03 m (moving traffic) of the surface of its own layer.

scenarios.description: Chase camera close to riding bicycles, seen three-quarter from behind: the riders are posed people on their saddles, hands on the bars, feet on the pedals
scenarios.why: docs/specs/terrain-following-bodies.md part 4: a Helsinki-centre street by day. The lineup draws a city bicycle and a mountain bike riding (engine on) just ahead of the taxi on its right, turned 70 degrees so the closest chase camera sees them three-quarter rather than from behind. The run fails unless a rider mesh with at least a walking person's vertex count was built and the riders are on screen within 9 m of the camera and at least 170 px high (about a quarter of the frame).
